description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Severity: High (calibrated). Found by /ship-it while babysitting the epic PR CI.

Concrete failure: the SAME command on the SAME commit produces pass locally and fail in CI. mix spec.check --base origin/main at a47d0fe reported findings=38 (error=0 warning=0 info=38) result=pass on a full clone, and findings=38 (error=0 warning=31 info=7) result=fail on a GitHub Actions runner. Identical finding set, different severities, opposite verdicts.

Mechanism: Ancora.Trailer reads Spec-Ack acknowledgments from the commit messages between base and HEAD. actions/checkout defaults to fetch-depth 1, so on a shallow clone those intermediate commits do not exist and their trailers are invisible. The findings then keep their registry default (change/uncovered_file is warning at lib/ancora/finding.ex:49) instead of the acknowledged info. Ancora emits NO diagnostic about this. The run looks completely normal.

Why it matters beyond this repo: every consumer runs ancora in CI, and CI clones are shallow by default. A governance gate whose verdict depends on how the repository was cloned is a gate nobody can trust, and the failure mode is silent in the direction that BLOCKS (extra warnings), which trains people to add continue-on-error. The inverse is worse: a repo whose trailers happen to be inside the shallow window gets a green that a full clone would fail.

Worked around on the epic branch in commit 57c1db6 by setting fetch-depth: 0 in ancoras own .github/workflows/ci.yml and dropping --depth=1 from the base fetch. That fixes THIS repo. It does not fix the tool.

Deliverable: detect the condition and refuse to be silent about it. Suggested shape, decision needed: at preflight, if git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository is true, either hard-fail with a tier=env message naming the remedy (git fetch --unshallow, or fetch-depth: 0), or emit a named finding so the run records that trailer resolution was degraded. A hard env failure matches the existing preflight_hard_fails posture and is probably right, since a partial answer from a gate is worse than a refusal. Also consider whether the shallow window should be checked against the actual base..HEAD range rather than the repo-wide shallow flag.

Add a standing test that constructs a shallow clone containing an acknowledged finding and asserts the run does not silently differ from the full-clone verdict.

Cannot land on the epic branch: it needs a new preflight condition plus a widening of ancora.gate.preflight_hard_fails, which is a contract decision.
title: Gate silently resolves a different verdict on a shallow clone
